results.title: Naqvi visits family of martyr captain Hamza Akram, offers condolences
results.description: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi visited martyr Captain Hamza Akram’s family, offered condolences and paid tribute to his courage and sacrifice during the Hangu operation.

results.title: Pedro Sánchez reminds that there are large family businesses
results.description: No one likes to go where they believe they will not be well received or where an ovation is not a given. That is what the Spanish Prime Minister, Pedro Sánchez, must have thought, as he last attended the Family Business Institute (IEF) congress in October 2018 in Valencia. From 2019 to 2025, he stopped attending, even though this powerful lobby had invited him. It includes some of the main companies controlled by families, from Mercadona to Banco Santander, Barceló, Banca March, Mango, or Amancio López's Hotusa, which joined last year.

results.title: Houthis claim attacks on Riyadh, Yanbu as Saudi tensions escalate
results.description: Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on sensitive targets in Riyadh and an Aramco facility in Yanbu, escalating tensions with Saudi Arabia. Riyadh said its air defences intercepted a ballistic missile and thwarted attempted attacks on several other locations.
